messages:
Aisha (AM): Quick: HealthCo POC blocked. They get logs but nothing ties to APM spans. Also our Splunk drain occasionally 403s and sometimes 429s.
Dev (SE): Can you paste one raw log + a span id from their APM? is the trace in a header or the body?
Aisha (AM): Raw log: 2026-05-04T08:22:10Z level=info msg="completed" endpoint=/chat trace_id=zz99yy88 user=healthco-prod
Their APM shows spans with full-uuid style ids (8-4-4-4-12) and they expect header X-HC-TRACE.
Dev (SE): Our collector preserves traceparent and b3. If their system looks only for X-HC-TRACE it won't join. @Rory any header stripping on the edge?
Rory (SRE): Edge strips unknown headers by default for security. We only forward: x-request-id, traceparent, b3, authorization, content-type. We have a per-tenant allowlist for additional headers.
Dev (SE): Two immediate fixes: 1) Enable per-tenant allowlist and map trace_id -> X-HC-TRACE for outbound so their APM joins; or 2) they add a small router rule to copy trace_id from body into span attribute. The first is faster for POC.
inga (Eng): Also seeing drain errors: ingest-bot shows 403s. Could be Authorization header being rewritten by their proxy. We can instead send token in X-Splunk-Token as fallback.
ingest-bot: drain job 9901 -> FAILED (403) to https://splunk.healthco:8088 (attempt 1)
reason: auth-failed or header-rewrite
Aisha (AM): HealthCo says token works in UI but fails when sent via our drain. They suspect edge rewrites Authorization.
Rory (SRE): I can flip the tenant flag to allow X-HC-TRACE and inject the header copied from trace_id field. I can also change the drain to send X-Splunk-Token instead of Authorization per tenant. Both low risk. Will roll in ~10m.
Dev (SE): Share curl examples for them to test both headers. I'll post them to #sales after deploy.
Aisha (AM): They want temporary higher drain throughput for the POC (bursting), can we allow that?
Nina (Eng): For short POC windows we can raise per-tenant rate_limit to 60/s for 48h. Need note for billing if extended.
ingest-bot: drain job 9902 -> SUCCESS to datadog-forwarder (latency 132ms)
Rory (SRE): Done: whitelist + mapping live, drain header switched to X-Splunk-Token for this tenant, rate bumped to 60/s for 48h. Monitoring.
Aisha (AM): Security Q: can HealthCo bring their own KMS for Private deployment? Need exact wording for the questionnaire.
Nina (Eng): For Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS/HSM. For Hosted we provide BYOK options for selected fields via integrations. I'll paste standard SOC2/KMS language into the questionnaire.
Aisha (AM): Next steps: Rory monitor; Nina update questionnaire and enable 30d retention trial; Dev to post curl examples; Aisha to validate on call 2026-05-04 14:00 UTC. Thanks all :thumbsup:
